opinions.point: Several viewers criticized the episode’s art and animation as unusually rough, with some saying the production quality hurt their enjoyment.
Some viewers found the episode entertaining or amusing despite its rough presentation, while others considered the execution unintentionally comedic.
A number of commenters enjoyed the developing romantic dynamic and found the episode’s character progression engaging.
Some viewers felt the romance advanced too quickly and that the protagonist’s communication and decision-making were frustrating.
Several commenters appreciated the historical details and the heroine’s growing independence and usefulness.
Viewers differed on the story’s quality: some called it compelling, while others described the writing and dramatic payoff as messy or anticlimactic.
